extracted.intended_audience: authors preparing responses to peer reviewers (early-career and experienced researchers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for authors on preparing response letters and revising manuscripts in reply to peer review comments, including handling ambiguous or sensitive reviewer requests and maintaining professional tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Context of the current literature
rubrics_metrics.description: Is the work placed in the context of the current literature?

rubrics_metrics.name: Factual statements supported by citations
rubrics_metrics.description: Are all factual statements correct and adequately supported by citations?

rubrics_metrics.name: Arguments supported by published evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: Are arguments sufficiently supported by evidence from the published literature?

rubrics_metrics.name: Balanced and justified conclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: Are the conclusions drawn balanced and justified on the basis of the presented arguments?

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive coverage of PRP strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: The manuscript should present a wide array of strategies and practical advice relevant to the peer review process, covering essential aspects of how to respond to reviewer comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Breadth provides authors with a robust toolkit for different scenarios; comprehensive coverage is especially valuable for early-career researchers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear section structuring
rubrics_metrics.description: Logical organization with well-defined headings and subheadings to aid readability and help readers navigate to relevant information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clear structure highlights key messages and increases utility as a reference guide; reduces reader burden when locating specific guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical and applicable advice
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice should be actionable so authors can readily apply it when responding to reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: break down complex reviewer comments into manageable parts and address each point methodically; provide concrete techniques rather than only abstract principles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on professionalism and constructive dialogue
rubrics_metrics.description: Advocate a balanced approach combining firmness in defending scholarly contributions with openness to constructive feedback, maintaining respectful and cooperative dynamics between authors and reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain a respectful tone in responses; promote constructive interactions rather than adversarial exchanges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Addressing requests to not cite specific authors
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide guidance on handling situations where reviewers request that specific authors not be cited due to reputational concerns or prior behavior.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Determine whether the request pertains to the individual or the research. If rooted in personal or ethical concerns, consider discreetly contacting the editor for guidance. Be mindful of post-publication peer review platforms (e.g., PubPeer) which may complicate citation decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledge reviewers when appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: Consider including reviewers in the acknowledgements section when their feedback has substantially contributed to improving the manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond thanking reviewers in the response letter, formal mention in acknowledgements demonstrates appreciation and recognizes reviewers' contribution to refining the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid plagiarism of reviewers' comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not directly copy and paste reviewers' comments into the manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If reviewers' comments suggest valuable improvements, paraphrase and integrate those ideas in the authors' own words to maintain originality and academic integrity. The page gives an extreme example where verbatim copying led to concern.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce redundancies and repetition
rubrics_metrics.description: Eliminate repeated points (e.g., repeated guidance on professionalism) to improve clarity and flow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Streamline similar points by consolidating them to make the manuscript more concise, engaging, and accessible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respond to every point raised
rubrics_metrics.description: Pay attention to details by addressing every point raised by reviewers in the response.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly respond to each comment (even if the response is to decline a suggested change), which demonstrates thorough engagement with the review and helps editors and reviewers track revisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Break down complex reviewer comments and address methodically
rubrics_metrics.description: When reviewer comments are complex, decompose them into manageable parts and address each sub-point methodically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This approach demystifies overwhelming feedback and ensures no element of a multi-part comment is overlooked.

rubrics_metrics.name: Express gratitude to reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Include statements of thanks to reviewers for their time and constructive feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expressing gratitude in the response letter (and, where appropriate, in acknowledgements) fosters goodwill and acknowledges reviewers' labor.
